items.title: Anthropic shares will debut on the stock market in a test for the AI boom
items.description: Anthropic’s record-breaking IPO raised $79 billion and values the company at roughly $1.5 trillion. Analysts consider its market debut a watershed event for the tech sector.

items.title: The world embraced the AI boom. Now many are having regrets.
items.description: Just as Anthropic is poised to go public, concerns are growing that immense investment in artificial intelligence won’t pay off.
